faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover Sport HSE use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year and generation. Early L320 (2005–2013) and L494 (2013–2022) models use TDV6/SDV6 or TDV8/SDV8 diesel V6/V8 engines. The current L461 generation (2022–present) uses Ingenium AJ300D (D300) diesel MHEV, AJ300P (P400) petrol MHEV, or BMW N63 (P530) V8 petrol engines. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Sport HSE engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400 for the TDV6/SDV6, £4,500 for V8 diesels, £2,800–£3,200 for Ingenium engines, and £6,500 for BMW-sourced V8s. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport HSE?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have a TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, AJ300D, AJ300P or BMW N63 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV6/SDV6 Range Rover Sport HSE engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every TDV6/SDV6 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV8/SDV8 Range Rover Sport HSE engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard — the same pattern as the TDV6/SDV6 family.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium D300 and P400 Range Rover Sport HSE engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. These newer engines are generally more reliable, and we service them to the same standard as our other Range Rover Sport rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Sport HSE engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Sport HSE if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Sport HSE engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Sport HSE owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
